Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Civ VI Aztecs, Tenochtitlan. Observed through turn 16/500, 3400 BC. Started turn 2: pop 1, Scout queued 6, Mining 9, Code of Laws 15; Eagle Warrior moved via portrait/command wheel. Map left-clicks do not issue orders; right-click a cyan-range hex moves a selected unit. Many right-clicks miss (tooltips, unit, invalid/mountain). Success = movement drops (2/2 to 1/2 or 0/2), UNIT NEEDS ORDERS clears, NEXT TURN appears (~0.91,0.72). PLEASE WAIT follows; wait actions often rejected stale while the turn already advances.

Production: many banner clicks failed. Choose Production opened via circular icon ~0.78,0.68. Scout replaced by Builder (10). Settler tooltip: needs pop 2 (city was 1). Turn 11 Mining done; popup closed with red X. Builder finished at city (2/2 move, 3 builds). CHOOSE RESEARCH opened tech list; Pottery selected (7 turns). Production then set to Slinger (5), not the intended Scout. Turns 12-15: Eagle Warrior kept needing orders beside a northern barbarian camp; Builder was moved around the city to 0/2 but never used a build charge (still 3).

Turn 16: Code of Laws complete. Advisor OK, Change Policies. Dragged Discipline into Military slot and God King into Economic slot (both checked). Confirm Policies opened dialog "Is our policy agenda set?" with Yes/No. Dozens of clicks across the dialog, including far left/right edges, did not close it; each was guessed to hit No. Confirmation still unresolved; Yes coordinate unknown.

Last reliable map state before the policy screen: Pottery 2 turns, gold 83, city pop 2, Eagle Warrior selected 2/2 near the camp, Builder charges unused, Slinger queued (remaining turns not rechecked). Active: confirm policies, then order the warrior, spend Builder charges, continue Pottery/Slinger.
